svg.text: RAIL ARENA / STOCK CONSTRUCTION
Broad cheek rest, thick shoulder pad, one compact reinforced opening, small recessed sling socket.

REFERENCE SHAPE INPUT
Orientation is reversed from the supplied photo:
shoulder pad at the left rear; receiver attachment at right.
Both faces share the same construction. Graphite contact
surfaces contrast with ivory structural armor. The lower
brace surrounds a single opening; the small socket is a
shallow cosmetic recess, not another stock cut-through.
New 300mm rear region within the 1.0m carbine target.
Contact fit and pad angle require creator review.
Reference study only. Source meshes and all views describe one version; no live Unity asset replaced.
